goal: Ingest AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations into logs-finops.rightsizing-default. Do not homegrown recs from Cost Explorer.

aws.opt_in: Enable Compute Optimizer in each workload account (or org management account with member enrollment).
aws.collector: ingest_compute_optimizer.py — boto3 Get* APIs for account 985408759551 / us-west-2, bulk to logs-finops.rightsizing-default.
aws.export: Create a daily Compute Optimizer export to S3 (EC2, EBS, Lambda, Auto Scaling, RDS, ECS on Fargate as licensed). Prefer organization export if available (later, multi-account).
ingest_options: ingest_compute_optimizer.py (current): aws compute-optimizer get-* → map finops.rightsizing.* → bulk
Elastic Agent aws s3 input (not agentless-managed identity-federation unless a queue_url exists) → parse CSV/JSON into finops.rightsizing.*
Lambda/S3 notification → ES bulk to logs-finops.rightsizing-default

field_map.finops.rightsizing.resource_type: Ec2Instance | EbsVolume | LambdaFunction | AutoScalingGroup | RdsDBInstance | EcsService
field_map.finops.rightsizing.action: map finding: OVER_PROVISIONED→downsize, IDLE→stop_idle, UNDER_PROVISIONED→upsize, OPTIMIZED→none (drop or hide)
field_map.finops.rightsizing.status: new recs start as open; preserve existing status/owner/case_id on the same finops.rightsizing.id

aws.hide_rules: Set status=hidden when performance_risk is High, resource is prod-tagged, savings below a floor, or operator marks the case infeasible toggle. Seeded samples use hidden_reason=seeded_sample.

elastic_already_applied.kpis: identified = open+in_progress (exclude hidden). captured = done. never add the two. Seeded sample recs stay status=hidden / hidden_reason=seeded_sample so they never enter Identified or Captured.

not_in_this_prep: Alerting when identified_usd exceeds a threshold
Marking recs unseen this pull as superseded
